description:
Hi! We're a team of two siblings from Instituto Salesiano San Miguel, in Honduras, and we love space! We're Edgar (11), and Isabella (9). We really like studying, especially math, and everything about the universe — planets, rockets, astronauts, and how everything works up there. We love asking questions, solving challenges, and discovering new things together.

Why join our team? We're responsible, we work well as a team, and we always help each other out. We like thinking with numbers, but we also love inventing and creating new ideas. We want to make an awesome project and have lots of fun learning along the way!

What are we looking for in a teammate? We'd love someone who knows how to code, someone creative who can help with drawings or the presentation, and someone who loves researching space stuff.
